entities.name: Alsadim K'mer
entities.description: Sainted One, a cleric of Shandalar who took command of the White Guild until its downfall.

entities.name: White Guild
entities.description: Guild of Shandalar commanded by Alsadim K'mer, with clerics, crusaders, paladins and arch angels.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Plane where Alsadim K'mer was a guildlord.

entities.name: Arzakon
entities.description: Evil planeswalker who corrupted the guildlords posing as a benevolent advisor and was banned from Shandalar.

entities.name: Guardian of Shandalar
entities.description: Protector of Shandalar betrayed by the guildlords.

entities.name: Arzakon's War
entities.description: War during which the guildlords betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar.

entities.name: Guildlords
entities.description: Leaders of the guilds of Shandalar corrupted by Arzakon.

events.summary: The guildlords, corrupted by Arzakon, betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar during Arzakon's War.
events.quote: Together, they betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar during Arzakon's War

events.summary: The Guildlords including Alsadim K'mer were defeated and Arzakon was banned from the plane.
events.quote: Arzakon was banned from entering the plane.

relations.note: He took command of the White Guild.
